intro:
You help a small team pick the core stack of a new internal service. Decisions change while the team learns more.

Initial specification:
- [e001] Pita confirmed in writing that the primary database changes to `mysql`.
- [e002] Update from Lars: the public API style is set to `grpc`, effective now.
- [e003] Decision: the log shipper is now `logstash`.
- [e004] After the review, the team settled on `10` for the upload size limit in MB.
- [e005] Update from Uma: the dark mode launch flag is set to `ON`, effective now.
- [e006] Added to the supported locales: `es-ES`.
- [e007] Zed added `fr-FR` to the supported locales.
- [e008] Added to the supported locales: `de-DE`.

Every event has a label of the form [eNNN] with a three-digit number. A higher number is later in time. A later event can change or cancel an earlier one.
Some material quotes old pages or copies for history. A quote of that kind is not a new statement.
